description: `platformAutomerge` hands the merge of an automerging PR to GitHub's native auto-merge, which lands it the moment the Protect Main ruleset's required checks pass, instead of on Renovate's next run (about hourly). Safe because the required set builds, tests and renders previews (yschimke/renovate-config repo-policy: assemble, Unit tests and Render previews); native auto-merge waits only on required checks, so it would not be safe on a repository whose ruleset required nothing.

packageRules.description: Remote Compose (`androidx.compose.remote`) and its Wear widget layer (`androidx.wear.compose.remote`) are released alphas from Google Maven again, so Renovate tracks them — but only as ONE PR. The two layers are compiled against each other (remote-material3 alpha10 declares remote-creation* alpha18), and a pair that moves apart fails preview render with NoSuchMethodError inside the creation API. They were pinned to an androidx-main snapshot until the creation API these cards need reached a release; `1.0.0-SNAPSHOT` names no single build, which is how two consumers of "the same" version ended up holding two and killed this catalog's live render lane on the preview server (yschimke/compose-preview-server#187). Re-render the previews when this moves: an alpha bump has changed creation-API signatures before.

compose-ai-tools ships the preview CLI, the ee.schimke.composeai Gradle artifacts (preview-annotations dep + the ee.schimke.composeai.preview plugin marker), and the reusable CI composite actions as a single release. Track it aggressively so CI always runs the latest renderer: group the pinned action refs and the Gradle coords into ONE PR so the CLI/plugin/dependency pins never skew apart, skip the weekly window, and automerge as soon as CI is green — the release moves several times a day and the pin is only useful if it keeps up. Regenerating the published catalog against the new renderer no longer depends on WHO merges: design-artifacts.yml has a push trigger on main covering the pins this PR touches, so a Renovate merge (app token — raises `push`) republishes on its own, and scheduled-merge.yml still dispatches design-artifacts.yml explicitly for the merges it makes itself (GITHUB_TOKEN merges raise no `push` event).

third-party-rc-embedded-player is the player data-remotecompose-connector draws every RemotePreview with. The connector keeps it compileOnly, so the version here must match the one the connector was compiled against, or every widget preview fails with RemoteComposeLinkageException and renders no PNG, which `missing-renders: warn` leaves green and the group above then automerges (#621: 2.21.0 changed RcPlayer's signature under connector 3.26.0). Hold it below 2.21.0 until a connector release links against the 2.21 player, then lift this together with that connector bump and re-render the widget previews.
